31: The Transmission Is What Matters -  how the word is to be written as it was transmitted to Moses, that is the manner in which we are to expound it, and not the way  it pronounced. When you read "V'nashal" you are inserting the pronunciation of a "Aleph" or of a "Hey" between the "Nun" and "Shin", however according to the authoritative tradition it is written as "V'nishal," meaning dislodged, i.e. that the iron caused [a splinter] to become dislodged from the wood [tree] which hit his fellow. Whereas the Rabanan are of the opinion that it the way it pronounced which matters, and it is read "V'nashal" as a verb, i.e. the iron [ax head] itself became dislodged from its wood [handle].
